quality, L.

कशा—त्रय n. three modes of whipping (a horse), W.
कशा—वत् (˚शा-), mfn. furnished with a whip, RV.

m: कशीका f. (= नकुली) a weasel (Sāy.), RV. i, 126, 6 (cf. कश, कषीका, and √ कष्.)

m: कश m. a species of rodent animal, VS.; TS. (cf. कशीका)
a whip, thong, MBh. (cf. प्रकश)
कश m. pl. N. of a people, BhP. (ed. Bomb.)
a: कशः — 1 A whip (usually in pl.). --शा A whip; इदानीं सुकुमारेऽस्मिन् निःशंकं कर्कशाः कशाः . तव गात्रे पतिष्यंति सहास्माकं मनोरथैः .. Mk. 9. 35 (where the word may be m. or f.) --2 Flogging. --3 A string, rope. --4 The mouth. --5 A quality.

कशकु Coix Barbata (= गवेधुका) Comm. on KātyŚr.
कशम्बूक अस्, m. a particular mythical being, Suparṇ. xxiii, 5.
कश—प्लक औ, m. du. ‘parts struck by the whip’, the hinder parts (originally of beasts of burden), [Gmn.; ‘pudenda muliebria’, BRD.], RV. viii, 33, 19 (cf. प्लक.)

m: कशस् n. moving, motion, TBr. i, 4, 8, 3
water, Naigh. i, 12 (v.l. शक, q.v.; cf. कशो-जू).

v: strI kaM jalaM vAtaM vA SfRAti SF--“ke Sra erakcAsya” uRA॰ U u vA । tfRakandaBede (keSura) ujjva॰ । dIrGAntaHtvazwuScaturdaSyAM 2 kanyAyAM sA ca narakAsureRa gajarUpeRa hftA tatkaTA harivaM॰ 121 a॰ yaTA “tvazwurduhitaraM BOmaH (narakAsuraH) kaSerUmagamattadA । gajarUpeRa jagrAha rucirANgIM caturdaSIm । pramaTya tAM varArohAM narakovAkyamabravIt” upratyayAntaH puMsi ca । “kiM kurvvatA varAheRa KAdyante hi kaSeravaH” । ujjva॰ candraH । hrasvAntaM klIvamAha amaraH । “SfNgAwakaM visaM drAkzA kaSeru maDukaM sitA” suSru॰ । svArTekan । tatrArTe na॰ । tadBedaguRA BAvapra॰ uktA yaTA । “kaSeru dviviDaM tattu mahadrAjakaSerukam । mustAkfti laGu syAdyattaccicowamiti smftam । kaSerukadvayam SItaM maDuraM tuvaraM guru । pittaSoRitadAhaGnaM nayanAmayanASanam । grAhi SukrAnilaSlezmarucistanyakaramparam । BAratavarzasya navaKaRqAntargate 3 KaRqaBede pu॰ “EndraM kaSeruSakalaM kila tAmraparRamanyadgaBastimadataSca kumArikAKyam । nAgaM ca sOmyamiha vAruRamantyaKaRqaM gAnDarvasaMjYamiti BAratavarzamaDye” si॰ Si॰ । purARasarvasve vizRupurAReca “BAratasyAsya varzasya nava BedAnniSAmaya । indradvIpaH kaSeruSca tAmravarRo gaBastimAn । nAgadvIpastaTA sOmyo gAnDarvastvaTa vAruRaH । ayantu (kumArikAKyaH) navamastezAM dvIpaH sAgarasaMvftaH । yojanAnAM sahasrantu dvIpo'yaM dakziRottarAt । pUrvve kirAtA yasyAnte paScime yavanAH sTitAH । brAhmaRAH kzatriyAvESyA maDye SUdrASca BAgaSaH । ijyAyudDavaRijyAdyE rvarttayantovyavasTitAH । vedasmftimuKAScAnyAH pAripAtrodBavA mune! । narmadAsurasAdyASca nadyovinDyavinirgatAH । tApIpayozRInirvvinDyAkAverIpramuKA nadI । godAvarIBImaraTIkfzRavenvAdikAstaTA । sahyapAdodBavAnadyaH smftAH pApaBayApahAH । hftAmalAtAmraparRIpramuKAmalayodBavAH । trisAmA fzikulyAdyA mahendrapraBavAH smftAH । fzikulyAkumArAdyAH SuktimatpAdasamBavAH । SatadrucandraBAgAdyA himavatpAdaniHsftAH । AsAM nadyupanadyaSca santyanyASca sahasraSaH । paScime kurupaYcAlamaDvadeSAdayojanAH । pUrvvadeSAdikAScEva kAmarUpanivAsinaH । oqrAH kaliNgamagaDA dAkziRAtyASca sarvvaSaH । taTA'parAntAH sOrAzwrAH SudDABIrAstaTArbudAH । mArukAmAlavAScEva pAripAtranivAsimaH । sOvIrAH senDavA hURAHSAlvAH SAkalavAsinaH । madrABArgAstaTAmvazWAH pArasIkAdayastaTA । AsAM pibantaH salilaM vasanti sahitAH sadA । catrAri BArate varze yugAnyatra mahAmune! । kftaM tretA dvAparaYca kaliScAnTatra na kvacit । tapastapyanti munayojuhvate cAtra yajvinaH । dAnAni cAtra dIyante paralIkArTamAdarAt । puruzEryajYapuruzo jambudvIpe sadejyate । tatrApi BArataM SrezWaM jambudvIpe mahAmune! । yato hi karmaBUrezA tato'nyABogaBUmayaH । atra janmasahasrARAM sahasrErapi sattamaH । kadAcillaBate janturmAnuzyaM puRyasaYcayAt । gAyanti devAH kila gItakAni DanyAstu ye BArataBUmiBAge svargApavargAspadahetuBUte Bavanti BUyaH puruzAH suratvAt । karmARyasaM kalpitatatPalAni sannyasya vizRO paramAtmarUpe । avApya tAM karmmamahImanante tasmilla~yaM ye tvamalAH prayAnti । jAnIma nEtat kva vayaMvilIne svargaprade karmmaRi dehabanDam । prApyATa DanTAH Kalu te manuzyA ye BArate cendriyasaNgahInAH । navavarzantu mEtreya! jambudvIpamidaM mayA । lakzayojanavistAraM saMkzepAt kaTitaM mayA” 4 pfzWadaRqasTni puMna॰ halA॰ svArTe kan । pfzWAsTiBede strI amaraH । tfRakaMnde'pi strI ratnamAlA “kaSerukaYcAtiyuktaM SlezakopakaM yaTAha suSrutaH । divAsvapnetyAdyupakrame “kaSerukaSfNgAwakamaDuravallIPalasamaSanADyaSanapraBftiBiH SlezmA kopamApadyate” । etadrasaSca kUlacaramAMsaBojane'nupAnam yaTAha anupAnavarge suSrutaH “kUlacarARAM SfNgAwakakaSerukAsavaH” । idaYca suSrute maDuravarge uktam । tadvAkyaM maDuravarge dfSyam । etasya Slezmapitta prakopakatvenakfmikAritvamuktam suSru॰ “mAzapizwAnnadvidalavisaSAlUkaSerukErityupakrame “SlezmA pittaM ca kupyati । kfmIn bahuviDAkArAn karoti viviDASrayAn” ।
m: कशेरु n. m. (fr. क, water or wind, + √ शॄ, Uṇ. i, 90; also written कसेरु) the back-bone, L.
कशेरु f(ऊस्)n. (Uṇ. i, 90) the root of Scirpus Kysoor (a kind of grass with a bulbous root), Suśr.

a: कशे(से)रु — m. n. 1 The backbone. --2 A kind of grass. --रुः One of the nine divisions of Jambudvīpa.

(sometimes spelt कसेरुक.)
a: कशेरुकः, कसेरुकः --का — A sort of grass. --का The back-bone.

कशिका f. a whip, Mṛcch.

v: pu॰ kaSati duHKam kaSyate vA kaSa--gatiSAsanayoH mfgayvA॰ ni॰ । 1 anne AcCAdane ca 2 amaraH । ekaSaktyA 3 BaktAcCAdanayoSca viSvaH । puzpavantAvityatreva ayaM dvivacanAntaH iti medi॰ । 4 SayyAyAm । “kxptEH kaSipuBiH kAntaM paryyaNkavyajanASanEH” BAga॰ 3, 23, 16 । “cedasti BUH kiM kaSipoH prayAsEH” BA॰ 2, 2, 5 । “kaSipoH SayyAyAH” SrIDaraH । 5 AsanaBede ca “kvacicCaye varopasTe tfRaparRRASmaveSmamu । kvacit prAsAdaparyyaNke kaSipO vA yaTecCayA” BAga॰ 7, 13, 37 । vede asya klIvatvamapi “pramucyASvaM dakziRena vedim hiraRmayaM kaSipUpastfRAti tasmin hotopaviSati” “hiraRmayayoH kaSipunoH purastAMt pratyaNNaDvaryyuH” Sata॰ brA॰ 13, 4, 3, 1 । “kaSipu AsanaBedaH । “hotraDvaryyU hiraRmayayoH kaSipunorupavizwO” kAtyA॰ 15, 6, 1 । kaSipuSabdena masUraka ucyate । “Palakamiti pitfBUtiH” saM॰ vyA॰ । “aDvaryyuyajamAnO kUrcayoH” “PalakayorvA, hotfbrahmodgAtAraH kaSipuzu” kAtyA॰ 20, 2, 2, 19, 20, 21 । “sapAdamAsanaM kUrcaH (kuraCIcOkI) “pAdarahitaM PalakaM kaSipuSabdena mfdvAsanaM masUraka ucyate” saMgra॰ vyA॰ । tena mfdvAsanaM pAdarahitaM PalakaM ca kaSipuSabdArTaH ।

a couch, BhP.

clothing, L.

m: कश्मीर m. pl. (ifc. f(आ). ; √ कश् ? perhaps contraction of कश्यप-मीर; cf. Rājat. i, 25; R. i, 70, 19), N. of a country and of the people inhabiting it (cf. काश्मीर) g. भर्गादि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 178

कश्यप m. N. of a mythical Ṛṣi, AitBr.; ŚBr.

of an ancient sage, VS.; AV. &c., (a descendant of Marīci and author of several hymns of the Ṛg-veda, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; he was husband of Aditi and twelve other daughters of Dakṣa, MBh. i, 2598; Mn. ix, 129; by Aditi he was father of the Ādityas [cf. काश्यपेय] TS.; ŚBr.; and of Vivasvat, R.; and of Viṣṇu in his वामन अवतार, R.; BhP.; VP.; by his other twelve wives he was father of demons, nāgas, reptiles, birds, and all kinds of living things; from the prominent part ascribed to him in creation he is sometimes called Prajā-pati; he is one of the seven great Ṛṣis and priest of Paraśu-rāma and Rāma-candra; he is supposed by some to be a personification of races inhabiting the Caucasus, the Caspian, Kaśmīr, &c.)
a patronymic from Kaśyapa, ŚBr.
the author of a Dharmaśāstra called Kaśyahollara-saṃhitā; the constellation Cancer (cf. Pers. kashaf), VP.
कश्यप m. pl. the descendants of Kaśyapa, AitBr.; ĀśvŚr.
a: कश्यपः — a. Having black teeth. --पः 1 A tortoise. --2 A sort of fish. --3 A kind of deer. --4 N. of a Ṛṣi, the husband of Aditi and Diti, and thus the father both of gods and demons, (so called because he drank कश्य ‘liquor;’ cf. कश्यपस्तस्य पुत्रोऽभूत् कश्यपानात् स कश्यपः . Mārk. P.) [He was the son of Marīci, the son of Brahmā. He bears a very important share in the work of creation. According to Mahābhārata and other accounts, he married Aditi and 12 other daughters of Dakṣa, and begot on Aditi the twelve Ādityas. By his other twelve wives he had a numerous and very diversified progeny: serpents, reptiles, birds, demons, nymphs of the lunar constellation. He was thus the father of gods, demons, men, beasts, birds and reptiles-in fact of all living beings. He is therefore often called Prajāpati]. --Comp. --नंदनः an epithet of Garuḍa.
